article.headline: Uelmen scores 24, North Dakota takes down South Dakota 72-71
article.description: — Greyson Uelmen's 24 points helped North Dakota defeat South Dakota 72-71 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Uelmen scores 24, North Dakota takes down South Dakota 72-71

event.description: North Dakota Fighting Hawks @ South Dakota Coyotes

keywords: North Dakota Fighting Hawks @ South Dakota Coyotes
article.story: VERMILLION, S.D. -- — Greyson Uelmen's 24 points helped North Dakota defeat South Dakota 72-71 on Wednesday. Uelmen shot 9 of 18 from the field and went 5 of 6 from the line for the Fightin' Hawks (15-13, 9-3 Summit League). Reggie Thomas scored 10 points and added three steals. Cameron Fens finished with 22 points, 12 rebounds and two blocks for the Coyotes (14-13, 6-6). South Dakota got 17 points and two blocks from Vince Buzelis. Jordan Crawford had 12 points and five assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
